name: code-facts
description: Read-only code navigation for bim-ootb, answered from the repo's own generated files: where an APP field is set, and which rule a §TAG stands for. No AI, no network, no dependencies.

commands.title: Code Facts: Cost if deployed (start-up and offline-cache bytes vs main)
Code Facts: Bump (check the changed files in the background, then press again to write)
Code Facts: Memory of the three pages (headless, vs main)

bimDevtools.compilerRoot.description: Path to the bim-compiler checkout, whose prompts/ and docs/ are also searched for §TAGs. Empty = a sibling folder ../bim-compiler next to bim-ootb.

bimDevtools.extraLogDirs.description: Folders outside the repo whose saved logs are also read for "values beside the code" (read-only, sub-folders included). A log counts only if it carries a §LOG_STAMP line. Empty list = only the checkout's own logs/.

bimDevtools.costBaseRef.description: The git ref "Cost if deployed" compares the working tree against.

bimDevtools.heapPages.description: The pages "Memory of the three pages" boots headless (no building beyond each page's own default sample) and compares against the cost base ref.

bimDevtools.liveSite.description: The live site "Fetch back" reads. Empty = derived from the git remote (https://<owner>.github.io/<repo>).
